definitions: To consume all of something, especially food.
To use a large amount of something, such as money, time, or resources.
To believe something completely, often something that is not true or is exaggerated.
examples: The children ate up all the cookies.
This new project will eat up a lot of our budget.
He ate up every word of her story, even though it sounded far-fetched.
pastTenses: ate up (simple past), eaten up (past perfect)
